_comment: Acceptance fixture for the card-count gate. Q8 forbids committing lyrics,
so this stores a HASH of the pinned lyrics plus the derived expectations --
never the lyric text. The test fetches LRCLIB, verifies the hash still
matches, and asserts the counts below.
If the hash mismatches, LRCLIB's stored text changed: re-measure and update
this file deliberately. Do not weaken the gate.
_expected_notes_note: 147 unique lemmas, measured end to end through the Dart pipeline against
the built pack and live LRCLIB -- not the 143 estimated during planning,
which came from simplemma plus a wordfreq proxy rather than the pack's own
It is 147 and not 148 because `tu` resolves under two parts of speech (det
and adj, both meaning 'your'). Q19 keys the Anki guid on 'es|<lemma>', so
two notes for one lemma would collide on import and silently lose the
second reading; the builder therefore merges them into ONE card carrying
both. The pack builder's own count of 148 counts (lemma, pos) PAIRS, so
the two numbers describe different things and both are correct.
All 147 carry a non-empty English gloss.
Homographs are kept: `me` glosses to 'me' and `metal` to 'metal'. These
are correct translations that happen to be spelled alike, not the
Spanish-defined-in-Spanish defect -- that one is excluded at pack build
time, where gloss_en can only come from English Wiktionary.
_unresolved_note: The 7 surfaces that resolve to no lemma are all non-Spanish: 4 ad-libs
(dididiri, fonsi, ohhh, woah) and 3 English loanwords (yeah, bang, daddy).
They are correctly absent from a Spanish vocabulary deck, so this list is
an assertion that the misses are the RIGHT misses -- if a real Spanish
word ever joins it, the pack regressed.
